prompt_name: You are a physics expert. From the video provide a brief description and calculate gravitational force between the two bodies on each other at the distance which is given in the figure. Consider both the bodies to be spherically symmetric. All the necessary values required are given in the video. Format your answer as Markdown. Use LaTeX for all mathematical notation.Use $...$ for inline equations. For display equations, put $$ on its own line before and after the equation. Do not wrap the response or equations in backticks or code fences.Use one backslash per LaTeX command, such as \frac or \sqrt.
